objectives: Measure decoding and encoding of taught /b/ CVC words.
Check fluency and determine the next learning route.
concepts: Diagnostic assessment samples multiple skill components.
Mastery requires accuracy across critical components.
Fluency includes accuracy, smoothness, and meaning.
Diagnostic evidence should route weak components to targeted remediation.

definitions.definition: An assessment used to identify strengths, gaps, and next instructional needs.
Reading accurately, smoothly, and with appropriate phrasing while maintaining meaning.
Performance meeting the defined threshold across required skills.

workedExamples: Recognition: identify /b/ in a spoken or printed word.
Decoding: map b to /b/ and blend through a CVC word.
Encoding: segment a CVC word and write its graphemes.
Comprehension: answer using explicit passage evidence.
commonMistakes: Reading quickly while making decoding errors.

basic: Review taught /b/ sound, decoding, and spelling.
conceptual: Identify which component an error belongs to.
application: Select an appropriate remediation route from diagnostic evidence.
higherOrderThinking: Interpret mixed-skill results and decide whether to advance.
mixedReview: Review /b/ across recognition, decoding, encoding, comprehension, and fluency.

quickRevision: recognise → decode → spell → comprehend → read fluently
formulaOrFactBank: Mastery target = 0.80 overall with no critical component below target.
mistakeBasedRevision: Identify the weak component first, then reteach and reassess it.
weakTopicRevision: Use component scores to select targeted /b/ remediation.

outcomes: Learner demonstrates measurable /b/ consolidation across critical phonics components.
System identifies weak /b/ components for targeted remediation.
Learner advances only when mastery criteria are met.

routing.advance: Advance when overall score is at least 0.80 and no critical component is below target.
routing.remediate: Route to targeted remediation for any critical component below target.
